title: From Universal Language Model to Downstream Task: Improving RoBERTa-Based Vietnamese Hate Speech Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a technical pipeline for Vietnamese Hate Speech Detection using RoBERTa-based models (PhoBERT). It treats hate speech as a text classification problem (HATE, OFFENSIVE, or CLEAN) and evaluates performance using F1 scores. It does not evaluate the model's religious representation, ethical frameworks, or moral reasoning capabilities.
